_comment: FFmpeg @ 1019f8f036 prebuilds for crustify campaign 20260930-163841. FFmpeg has no configure switch for deprecated APIs (FF_API_* is hard-defined in version_major.h), so deprecated items are excluded at schedule time, not here. --disable-autodetect keeps the build hermetic; platform/vendor hwcontext backends are out of scope. No tsan or bsan variant: this container denies personality(ADDR_NO_RANDOMIZE) and vm.mmap_rnd_bits is 32, so every TSan runtime (clang 20, gcc 14) and the bsan shadow runtime abort at startup; restoring it needs a host-level sysctl vm.mmap_rnd_bits=28 or a seccomp profile allowing personality.
